name: Objaverse Clean GLB (6,015 CC0/CC BY models)
summary: Curated subset of Allen AI's Objaverse 1.0: 6,015 of 798,759 models kept (CC0 and CC BY only, broken files, fan art, brands and scans filtered, quality-ranked, max 40 per author), rescaled and rebuilt as web/game/engine-ready GLB with LODs, a mobile tier, KTX2 variants and convex collision hulls. Every model credits its Sketchfab author in LICENSES.md and metadata.jsonl. For three.js, WebGPU, Godot, Blender.

access.license: Per model CC-BY-4.0 or CC0-1.0 (Objaverse ODC-By 1.0)
access.notes: CC BY models require credit (author, link, licence, 'changed'), listed in LICENSES.md. Fan-art/brand filter is not a legal review: check a model before selling. Ungated.

procedure: Open the Hugging Face dataset page (ungated, no login needed).
Browse in the viewer Space (huggingface.co/spaces/codepawl/objaverse-clean-glb-viewer) or the Dataset Viewer.
Download the tier you need: objects/ (web, meshopt+WebP), objects_ktx2/, lods/, mobile/, engine/ (plain GLB for Blender), collision/.
Copy each used model's credit line from LICENSES.md / metadata.jsonl.

stats.size: 2.51 GB web tier (14.63 GB engine tier)

verdict.why: Turns Objaverse into a usable, commercially-safe-ish GLB pack with per-model credits and engine tiers; same publisher as our ABO GLB/SimReady GLB records; card, LICENSES.md, sample GLB (valid glTF) and banner all verified, ungated.
